verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street has a startup-founder O-1 resource saying founders can apply if they show extraordinary ability (docs-19). It also notes that an agent can petition instead of an employer (docs-14), which only hints at alternative petitioner setups. Nothing in the pack explains how a founder's own company can act as petitioner. missing for 10: documentation of beneficial-ownership rules, board or employer control arrangements for a founder-owned petitioner, coverage of the 2023+ USCIS founder guidance, independent corroboration.
